notes.content: ** Fixed the bug mech can not move

notes.title: 0.3.12 Update
notes.content:
** Fixed the bug causing partial blueprint data loss after logging off.
** Added penalty time (5~15 minutes) for non-acceptance after a successful match.

notes.title: 0.3.11 Update
notes.content:
** Fixed the issue where shield number stickers were not displaying.
** Added transition sound effects from the main menu to the matchmaking interface.
** Added countdown sound effects during matchmaking.
** Updated some status icons.
** Updated some weapon preview images.
** Removed the display of mech qualities on the matchmaking loading screen.

notes.title: 0.3.10 update
notes.content:
** Fixed incorrect skill descriptions in Korean.
** Fixed a bug causing the camera to switch perspectives when there weren't enough matchmaking attempts.
** Fixed an issue with the Sniper's Shot skill indicator abnormally disappearing.
** Added individual ranking display to the leaderboards.

notes.title: 0.3.9 update
notes.content:
Fix：
1. Fixed partial localization errors (Japanese, Korean, Russian)
2. Fixed a bug where in-battle mechs' quality tag is displayed incorrectly.
3. Fixed a bug where Leaderboard displays incorrect personal tag.
4. Fixed a bug where Hangar TAA is ineffective.
5. Fixed a bug in the Hangar interface when you hide UI and open Settings, upon returning to the interface it will display error.
6. Fixed Find Match 6900 error.
Improved:
1. Skill tips added energy consumption display.
2. Match Found interface now hides opponent name display.
3. PvP Loading interface added mech quality display.
4. New Blueprint scene resources updated.
